speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned experiencing sudden-onset vertigo; can you describe exactly what that sensation feels like and if you experience any nausea or vomiting?

speaker: Patient
text: 59-year-old male. The patient presents to the emergency department with a sudden-onset sensation that the room is spinning, leading to several episodes of nausea and vomiting. The symptoms started as he was going to bed and lasted for approximately 3 minutes. He mentions that he has never experienced anything like this before and currently feels at his baseline.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)

The brief 3-minute duration and the fact that you are currently back to your baseline are classic for BPPV. Have you noticed if the spinning sensation recurred when you rolled over in bed or looked up? REQUEST IMAGES: Dix-Hallpike test results.
